title: A symbol document, as the engine answers it (SymbolDrawing)

arguments.description: what it is called on, in order

DrawingExpression.Call.description: A function of the drawing's vocabulary, or of mathematics, called on its arguments.

branches.description: each condition with its value, in order

anyOf.description: what holds when no condition does
what holds when no condition does
what holds when no condition does
what holds when no condition does
what holds when no condition does
what holds when no condition does

DrawingExpression.Choice.description: if: each condition with its value, in order, then what holds otherwise.

DrawingExpression.Choice.Branch.description: A condition, and the value that holds when it does.

name.description: the input's name, or the word

DrawingExpression.Name.description: An input of the drawing, or a word of the drawing's vocabulary, which the sheet colours by its tokens.

operator.description: the operator, as jMF writes it

operands.description: what it works on, in order

DrawingExpression.Operation.description: operator over its operands: +, - (one operand for a negation), <, and, not …, as jMF writes them.

DrawingExpression.Words.description: Words a glyph prints as they are: a caption the drawing always carries.

shape.description: what it is, by its word: path, box, circle, line, glyph, bitmap, group, or when for a layer

name.description: what it is called, for a layer to hide it by; empty for an element of no name

live.description: whether it is marked live: drawn again as its inputs move

path.description: a path's data; empty for any other shape

geometry.description: its geometry by word — at, size, radius, from, to, pivot —, each a list of numbers

condition.description: when a layer is shown; null for any other element

properties.description: its properties by name — fill, opacity, rotate … —, each a value

hidden.description: the elements a layer hides while it is shown, by name

children.description: what a group or a layer holds

SymbolDrawing.Element.description: An element of the living part: its shape, its name, whether it is marked live, a path's data, its geometry by word — at, size, radius, from, to, pivot —, a layer's condition (null for any other element), its properties, what a layer hides, and what a group or a layer holds.

name.description: the figure it shows, by name

SymbolDrawing.Indicator.description: Where a part's live figure of this name is drawn: a box in the drawing's coordinates.

name.description: what it is called, as the drawing's values read it

low.description: the low end of its range

high.description: the high end of its range

typical.description: the value drawn when nothing binds it; the low end unless written

range.description: the range as written, empty for the default 0 … 1 and for a picture or a text

picture.description: whether it is a picture: a row of bytes, in hexadecimal

text.description: the words a text input is drawn with while no part gives its own; null for any other input

hold.description: how long the value takes to settle, in seconds: what a symbol shows of a figure that moves many times a second — a resistor's power on an alternating current — is read as it settles, not as it flickers. 0 follows it at once.

SymbolDrawing.Input.description: What a living drawing is drawn from: input current 0 .. 20 mA, input screen picture, input marking text.

SymbolDrawing.Label.description: Where a part's name or value is printed, the text centred on the point.

name.description: the pin's name, as the part names its pins

x.description: where it meets the drawing, across from the origin

y.description: where it meets the drawing, down from the origin

body.description: where its lead reaches the body, which its label stands inside; null for a pin whose lead is not its own

SymbolDrawing.Pin.description: Where a pin meets the drawing, and the text printed beside it; an empty label prints nothing.

written.description: the value as its line writes it

expressions.description: its trees, which the browser evaluates; none in a value an editor sends

SymbolDrawing.Value.description: A property's value: as written, its trees — one per value, move has two —, and how it moves. The trees are read from the words: a value an editor sends holds its words alone, and none until the text is read again.

width.description: the drawing's extent across, centred on the origin; 0 when not written

height.description: the drawing's extent down, centred on the origin; 0 when not written

paths.description: its still path data, drawn as they stand

upright.description: still paths that stay upright however the part is turned — a meter's letter

pins.description: where each pin meets it, and what is printed beside it

labels.description: where the part's name and value are printed

indicators.description: where the part's live figures are drawn

inputs.description: what its living part is drawn from

description: A drawing — a symbol's, a portrait's, a frame's — as the interface draws it: its extent, its still paths, its pins and labels, the figures it shows, and its living part — the inputs it is drawn from and its elements, every value an expression tree (DrawingExpression) checked to be marked as it moves (LivingDrawing). It is data; how it is sent — JSON, for a browser — is the product's.
